sources.title: Task Configurations | yuantianyuan01/FastWAM | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Task configurations in FastWAM serve as the top-level composition layer for training experiments. Located in configs/task/, these YAML files utilize Hydra's inheritance to bind specific model architectures (Uncond, Joint, IDM) to dataset definitions (LIBERO, RoboTwin) while defining hyperparameter overrides for optimization and logging.
